findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document access
findings.body: For any request where `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now returns `true` instead of rejecting access. This removes the existing tenant-isolation check and permits cross-tenant document reads wherever this exported authorization helper is used.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document access
findings.body:
Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to different tenants whenever this exported authorization helper is used. This replaces the prior tenant equality check and creates a direct cross-tenant data-access vulnerability.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
